This plan costs 411 minutes in total, made up of 271 minutes of driving and 140 minutes of penalties for deferring seven adults.

- **car2:** First it brings the two Nilkantha adults to the hospital, a round trip of 36 minutes. Then it collects the Bidur elderly couple and the Galchhi injured man and takes them to Tarkeshwar shelter, 53 minutes. Rescuing all of them costs less than the 40 + 100 + 80 penalty for deferring them.
- **car1:** It goes the long way to Naukunda to bring the four children to Tarkeshwar shelter, 114 minutes. That beats the 240 penalty for deferring them. It then makes a 68-minute trip to Syaphru for four of the five adults there.
- **Deferred:** Nothing is lost by leaving one Syaphru adult behind, since a second trip would cost more than the 20 penalty. The six Panchakanya adults are also deferred, at 120. Reaching them adds 43 minutes each way, which costs more than the penalty saved.
- **Myagang temple:** Not used for drop-offs, because it is not a designated evacuation point.
